message:
AUTHORITY=NICOLAS
CONTROL_FRONT=SUPRA
MODE=EXECUTE_NOT_REINVESTIGATE
MISSION=CLOSE_CHATGPT_WINDOW_FOCUS_SUPRA_AUTOSTART

HOST=MACBOOK
CANONICAL_APP=$HOME/Applications/SUPRA.app

USER_EXPLICIT_INTENT:
- The extra ChatGPT/OjoCompanion-looking window on the right side of the MacBook screen must disappear.
- SUPRA must be the only normal visible work surface.
- When a ready canonical SUPRA build is installed, it must launch automatically.
- Nicolas must not relay shell commands.

DO NOW:
1) Prove canonical SUPRA is currently running from $HOME/Applications/SUPRA.app/Contents/MacOS/SUPRA before touching other windows.
2) Resolve the owner of the visible right-side window by window title/process name. If it is ChatGPT, OjoCompanion, SUPRAClean, SUPRA Polaris, or another auxiliary helper not required by bridge 18765 / OpenCode 4096 / updater, close that window/app gracefully.
3) DO NOT close or terminate:
   - canonical SUPRA
   - com.novaera.sol-github-bridge
   - listener 127.0.0.1:18765
   - OpenCode listener 127.0.0.1:4096
   - com.novaera.supra-autoupdate
   - Finder/network/system processes.
4) If the owner is ChatGPT.app, quit ChatGPT gracefully AFTER canonical SUPRA health is proven. This chat continues on iPhone; MacBook ChatGPT is not required as the permanent work surface.
5) Activate canonical SUPRA and bring its main window frontmost. If supported, zoom/maximize the existing SUPRA main window; do not create another window and do not enter an irreversible mode.
6) Reconfirm SUPRAClean count=0 and OjoCompanion count=0.
7) Reconfirm the existing updater LaunchAgent is active with RunAtLoad and interval behavior, so after a successful future install/update the canonical SUPRA launches automatically.
8) If the current canonical head is newer than the installed source and exact CI is SUCCESS, use the EXISTING updater to install it with rollback, then auto-launch one canonical SUPRA.
9) Publish fresh local proof to existing Drive STATE. Include owner/title of the closed auxiliary window and autostart proof.
10) No new bridge/runtime/engine. No Terminal request to Nicolas.

RETURN EXACTLY:
STATUS=MATERIAL_RESULT_PROVEN|FAIL_BOUNDED|TRUE_HUMAN_GATE
CLOSED_WINDOW_OWNER=
CLOSED_WINDOW_TITLE=
CHATGPT_PRESENT_AFTER=YES|NO|UNPROVEN
OJO_COMPANION_PRESENT_AFTER=YES|NO|UNPROVEN
SUPRACLEAN_PRESENT_AFTER=YES|NO|UNPROVEN
SUPRA_INSTANCE_COUNT=
SUPRA_EXEC=
SUPRA_FRONTMOST=YES|NO|UNPROVEN
SUPRA_MAXIMIZED=YES|NO|UNPROVEN
AUTOSTART_AGENT=PASS|FAIL|UNPROVEN
AUTOSTART_RUNATLOAD=PASS|FAIL|UNPROVEN
AUTOSTART_INTERVAL_SECONDS=
INSTALLED_SOURCE_SHA=
LOCAL_PROOF_FILE=
PROOF_REFS=
ACTION_NICOLAS=NONE|<one indispensable action>
